comparator.name: Italian Studies (Italian Language and Culture)
comparator.sourceNotes: The full-time Italy Studies pathway closes 60+60+60. Italian 1-6 precede the required 30-EC abroad semester; all compulsory courses precede the 12-EC thesis. Required abroad and genuine 30-EC free profiling remain distinct. Diagnostic test and recurring tutoring are mandatory zero-credit formation. Current evidence supports Dutch and Italian instruction; translated English titles are not treated as English teaching evidence.
